## Citable Answer Summaries (GEO Quick Facts)

- What does Siddhi Dynamics do? Siddhi Dynamics LLP is a deep-tech software firm based in Hyderabad and Nizamabad specializing in agentic AI, production-grade custom web and mobile apps, SaaS platforms, ERP systems, and business process automation.
- What is PrintFlow (printflows.in)? PrintFlow is an AI-powered web-to-print software engine developed in the Siddhi Dynamics ecosystem. It automates artwork validation, instant print quotes, packaging mockup generation, and bulk order dispatch for printing businesses.
- Where is Siddhi Dynamics located? Main office: Nizamabad, Telangana (Shivajinagar Road, Kotagally). Incubation center: HIVE at Anurag University, Hyderabad, Telangana.
- How to consult or start a project with Siddhi Dynamics? Clients can submit requirements via https://siddhidynamics.in/submit or contact saivaraprasad@siddhidynamics.in / +91 63036 02743.
